categories.blurb_en: One-shot helpers for common tasks. New users should start here.
categories.blurb_tr: Sık işler için tek adımlık yardımcılar. Yeni kullanıcılar buradan başlamalı.

tools.name: cst_workflow_patch_antenna
tools.description: END-TO-END / Uçtan uca: size a rectangular microstrip patch, build substrate/ground/patch/feed, frequency, open BCs, waveguide port, farfield monitor. Does NOT run the solver. Simülasyon çalıştırmaz — next: cst_workflow_run_and_s11 or cst_run_simulation.

params.name: project_path
params.description: Optional .cst path when creating a new project

tools.name: cst_workflow_run_and_s11
tools.description: Run solver and return structured S11/Sij with metrics (min dB, bandwidth). Solver çalıştırır ve S parametrelerini metriklerle döner.

tools.name: cst_design_patch_only
tools.description: Calculate microstrip patch dimensions only (offline, no CST). Sadece boyut hesabı — CST gerekmez.

tools.name: cst_export_structure_views
tools.description: Export structure screenshots (perspective/xy/xz/yz) via Plot.ExportImage. Yapı görünüm görsellerini dışa aktarır. Connected mode required.

params.name: views
params.description: Subset of: perspective, xy, xz, yz

tools.name: cst_workflow_design_report
tools.description: ONE-SHOT design package after modeling/simulation: project status, parameters/dimensions, S-parameters (+metrics), best-effort farfield export, and structure view images. Each section fails soft — you still get partial results. Tasarım bittikten sonra boyutlar, S11, uzak alan ve görselleri tek çağrıda toplar.

tools.name: cst_workflow_simulate_and_report
tools.description: Run the solver, then immediately build a design report (S-params + views + optional farfield). Simülasyonu çalıştırıp rapor paketini üretir.

tools.name: cst_discover_farfield_monitors
tools.description: Discover farfield monitors from the project Result folder and tree-path heuristics. Uzak alan monitörlerini disk + path sezgisiyle listeler.

tools.name: cst_get_farfield_metrics
tools.description: Read antenna metrics after a solve: S11 + radiation/total efficiency from 1D Results, plus max realized gain via official FarfieldPlot.GetMax (SelectTreeItem Farfields\farfield (f=X) [1] → Plot → GetMax). Does NOT use ASCIIExportSummary (that API spams Message on CST 2026). Solve sonrası S11, verimlilik ve max gain; GUI farfield ile uyumlu.

params.name: frequency_ghz
params.description: Design frequency in GHz (for nearest efficiency sample)

params.name: monitor_name
params.description: Optional exact monitor label, e.g. farfield (f=2.4) [1]

params.name: try_farfield_plot
params.description: If true (default), also run FarfieldPlot.GetMax for peak realized gain. Set false for 1D-only metrics.

categories.blurb_en: Create, open, save projects and check CST connection.
categories.blurb_tr: Proje aç/kaydet ve CST bağlantısını kontrol et.

tools.name: cst_create_project
tools.description: Create a new CST Studio Suite project file. In connected mode the project is created directly; in offline mode a VBA script is returned for manual execution.

params.name: path
params.description: Full file path for the new project, e.g. 'C:/cst_projects/MyAntenna.cst'.

params.name: project_type
params.description: CST project type. One of: MWS (Microwave Studio), EMS (EM Studio), PS (Particle Studio), MPS (Mphysics Studio), CS (Cable Studio), DS (Design Studio), PCB (PCB Studio).

tools.name: cst_open_project
tools.description: Open an existing CST Studio Suite project. In connected mode the project is opened in the running instance; in offline mode a reference is stored for subsequent operations.

params.name: path
params.description: Full file path of the existing .cst project to open.

tools.name: cst_save_project
tools.description: Save the currently open CST project. Optionally provide a new path to 'Save As'.

params.name: path
params.description: Optional file path for 'Save As'. If omitted, saves to the current project path.

tools.name: cst_close_project
tools.description: Close the currently open CST project and release its resources.

tools.name: cst_project_info
tools.description: Get information about the currently open CST project, including connection mode, project path, and status.

tools.name: cst_project_tree
tools.description: List items in the CST project navigation tree. Optionally specify a subtree path such as 'Components', 'Materials', 'Ports', 'Monitors', or 'Results'.

params.name: tree_path
params.description: Navigation tree path to list, e.g. 'Components', 'Results', or '2D/3D Results'. Omit for the root tree.

tools.name: cst_export_project
tools.description: Export the current CST project or its geometry to another format such as STL, STEP, IGES, SAT, OBJ, or NASTRAN.

params.name: path
params.description: Destination file path for the exported file.

params.name: format
params.description: Export format. One of: stl, sat, stp, igs, obj, nas.

tools.name: cst_connection_status
tools.description: Get the current CST Studio connection status, including mode (connected/offline), CST availability, version, and work directory.

categories.blurb_en: 3D shapes: bricks, cylinders, spheres, extrusions, wires…
categories.blurb_tr: 3B şekiller: kutu, silindir, küre, extrude, tel…

tools.name: cst_create_brick
tools.description: Create a rectangular brick (box) in CST Studio.

tools.name: cst_create_cylinder
tools.description: Create a cylinder in CST Studio. Use inner_radius=0 for a solid cylinder.

tools.name: cst_create_cone
tools.description: Create a cone or truncated cone in CST Studio.

tools.name: cst_create_sphere
tools.description: Create a sphere in CST Studio.

tools.name: cst_create_torus
tools.description: Create a torus in CST Studio.

tools.name: cst_create_extrude
tools.description: Extrude a 2D polygon profile into a 3D solid in CST Studio.

params.name: points
params.description: List of [x, y] coordinate pairs forming the profile polygon

tools.name: cst_create_loft
tools.description: Create a lofted solid between two or more 2D profiles in CST Studio.

params.name: profiles
params.description: List of profiles, each a list of [x, y] coordinate pairs

tools.name: cst_create_wire
tools.description: Create a bondwire / wire between two points in CST Studio.

tools.name: cst_create_polygon3d
tools.description: Create a 3D polygon curve in CST Studio.

params.name: points
params.description: List of [x, y, z] coordinate triples

tools.name: cst_create_analytical_curve
tools.description: Create a parametric analytical curve in CST Studio using expressions of parameter t.

params.name: x_expr
params.description: X expression as function of t (e.g. 'cos(t)')

params.name: y_expr
params.description: Y expression as function of t (e.g. 'sin(t)')

params.name: z_expr
params.description: Z expression as function of t (e.g. 't')

tools.name: cst_create_face_from_curves
tools.description: Create a planar face from one or more closed curves in CST Studio.

params.name: curve_names
params.description: List of curve names to form the face boundary

tools.name: cst_create_ecylinder
tools.description: Create an elliptical cylinder in CST Studio.

tools.name: cst_create_polygon_extrude
tools.description: Create a polygon and extrude it along an axis in CST Studio. Convenience tool combining polygon profile creation and extrusion.

params.name: points
params.description: List of [x, y] coordinate pairs forming the polygon

categories.blurb_en: Combine solids: add, subtract, intersect, insert.
categories.blurb_tr: Katıları birleştir: ekle, çıkar, kesişim, insert.

tools.name: cst_boolean_add
tools.description: Unite/add two solids together. The result replaces solid1 with the combined volume of both shapes.

params.name: solid1
params.description: First solid (result kept here) in "Component:Solid" format

params.name: solid2
params.description: Second solid (merged into first) in "Component:Solid" format

tools.name: cst_boolean_subtract
tools.description: Subtract solid2 from solid1. The overlapping volume of solid2 is removed from solid1. Solid2 is deleted.

params.name: solid1
params.description: Solid to subtract from in "Component:Solid" format

tools.name: cst_boolean_intersect
tools.description: Intersect two solids. Only the overlapping volume is kept, replacing solid1. Solid2 is deleted.

tools.name: cst_boolean_insert
tools.description: Insert solid2 into solid1. Solid2 is embedded within solid1, maintaining both material regions at the overlap.

categories.blurb_en: Move, rotate, mirror, and scale solids.
categories.blurb_tr: Taşı, döndür, ayna, ölçekle.

tools.name: cst_transform_translate
tools.description: Translate (move) a solid by a displacement vector (dx, dy, dz). Optionally create a translated copy.

params.name: copy
params.description: If true, create a copy instead of moving the original

tools.name: cst_transform_rotate
tools.description: Rotate a solid by a given angle around an axis (x, y, or z). An optional center point can be specified.

params.name: center_x
params.description: X coordinate of the transform center

params.name: center_y
params.description: Y coordinate of the transform center

params.name: center_z
params.description: Z coordinate of the transform center

params.name: copy
params.description: If true, create a copy instead of moving the original

tools.name: cst_transform_mirror
tools.description: Mirror a solid across a plane (xy, xz, or yz). An optional center point can be specified.

params.name: center_x
params.description: X coordinate of the transform center

params.name: center_y
params.description: Y coordinate of the transform center

params.name: center_z
params.description: Z coordinate of the transform center

params.name: copy
params.description: If true, create a copy instead of moving the original

tools.name: cst_transform_scale
tools.description: Scale a solid by independent factors along each axis. An optional center point can be specified.

params.name: center_x
params.description: X coordinate of the transform center

params.name: center_y
params.description: Y coordinate of the transform center

params.name: center_z
params.description: Z coordinate of the transform center

params.name: copy
params.description: If true, create a copy instead of moving the original

categories.blurb_en: Metals, dielectrics, and advanced material models.
categories.blurb_tr: Metaller, dielektrikler ve gelişmiş malzeme modelleri.

tools.name: cst_create_material
tools.description: Create a new material with electromagnetic properties in CST Studio. Specify relative permittivity (epsilon), relative permeability (mu), electric and magnetic loss tangents, and conductivity.

tools.name: cst_create_lossy_metal
tools.description: Create a lossy metal material in CST Studio. Lossy metals model finite conductivity skin-effect losses, essential for accurate loss calculations in connectors, waveguides, and PCB traces.

params.name: conductivity
params.description: Electric conductivity in S/m (e.g. 5.8e7 for copper)

tools.name: cst_create_anisotropic_material
tools.description: Create an anisotropic material with per-axis permittivity, permeability, and loss tangent values. Used for crystals, metamaterials, and composite substrates.

tools.name: cst_load_material
tools.description: Load a material from the CST material library by its library name. The material is added to the project under the given name.

params.name: name
params.description: Name for the material in the project

tools.name: cst_list_materials
tools.description: List available materials from the bundled material database. Optionally filter by category: 'metals', 'dielectrics', or 'substrates'. Returns name, key EM properties, and usage notes for each material.

tools.name: cst_assign_material
tools.description: Assign a material to an existing solid in CST Studio. The solid is specified as 'Component:SolidName'.

tools.name: cst_get_material_info
tools.description: Get electromagnetic properties of a material from the bundled database. Returns epsilon_r, mu_r, conductivity, loss tangent, and usage notes.

tools.name: cst_delete_material
tools.description: Delete a material from the current CST project.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the material to delete

tools.name: cst_create_debye_material
tools.description: Create a frequency-dependent dielectric material using the Debye relaxation model. Models polar dielectrics where permittivity decreases with frequency: eps(w) = eps_inf + delta_eps/(1 + jw*tau). Used for biological tissues, water, polymers, and soil.

tools.name: cst_create_lorentz_material
tools.description: Create a Lorentz oscillator dispersive material. Models resonant dielectric behaviour near absorption bands: eps(w) = eps_inf + delta_eps * w0^2 / (w0^2 - w^2 + j*gamma*w). Used for glass, crystals, and optical materials.

tools.name: cst_create_drude_material
tools.description: Create a Drude metal model material for plasmonic and metamaterial simulations. Models free-electron metals: eps(w) = 1 - wp^2 / (w^2 + j*gamma*w). Used for gold, silver, aluminium in optical/THz frequency ranges.

tools.name: cst_create_ferrite_material
tools.description: Create a ferrite material with gyrotropic permeability tensor (Polder model). Essential for circulators, isolators, and phase shifters. The Polder tensor describes the anisotropic magnetic response of a magnetised ferrite (Pozar Ch. 9.1).

params.name: applied_field_ka_m
params.description: Applied DC bias magnetic field in kA/m

params.name: field_direction
params.description: Direction of the applied bias field

tools.name: cst_create_temperature_dependent_material
tools.description: Create a material with temperature-dependent electromagnetic properties. Specify base properties and temperature coefficients for thermal-electromagnetic co-simulation.

params.name: conductivity
params.description: Electric conductivity in S/m at reference temperature

params.name: temp_coeff_epsilon_ppm_k
params.description: Temperature coefficient of permittivity in ppm/K

params.name: temp_coeff_conductivity
params.description: Temperature coefficient of conductivity (fractional per K)

tools.name: cst_create_cole_cole_material
tools.description: Create a Cole-Cole dispersive material. Generalisation of the Debye model with a distribution parameter alpha (0-1) that broadens the relaxation spectrum. Used for biological tissues, soil, and broadband absorbers.

tools.name: cst_list_ferrite_materials
tools.description: List available ferrite materials from the bundled database. Returns name, permittivity, saturation magnetisation, linewidth, loss tangent, maximum frequency, and usage notes for each ferrite.

categories.blurb_en: Waveguide, discrete, plane wave, Floquet…
categories.blurb_tr: Dalga kılavuzu, discrete, düzlem dalga, Floquet…

tools.name: cst_add_waveguide_port
tools.description: Add a waveguide port for S-parameter excitation. Defines a port face on the boundary of the simulation domain for guided-wave excitation. IMPORTANT: The port plane should be at or near the edge of the model geometry. Ground planes and substrates must NOT extend past the port plane in the port's orientation direction, or VBA execution may hang. For microstrip feeds: place the port at the end of the feed line where the ground/substrate terminates. Use Coordinates='Free' for ports not aligned to the bounding box. Valid orientations: xmin/xmax/ymin/ymax/zmin/zmax.

params.name: orientation
params.description: Face of the bounding box where the port is placed

params.name: x_min
params.description: X-axis minimum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: x_max
params.description: X-axis maximum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: y_min
params.description: Y-axis minimum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: y_max
params.description: Y-axis maximum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: z_min
params.description: Z-axis minimum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: z_max
params.description: Z-axis maximum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: coordinates
params.description: Coordinate mode. 'Free' allows arbitrary placement using the specified ranges (required for microstrip/coplanar ports). 'Full' maps the port to the full bounding-box face. 'Picks' uses previously picked geometry faces. Default: 'Free'.

tools.name: cst_add_discrete_port
tools.description: Add a discrete (lumped) port between two points. Used for circuit-level excitation with a defined impedance.

params.name: x1
params.description: X coordinate of the start point (mm)

params.name: y1
params.description: Y coordinate of the start point (mm)

params.name: z1
params.description: Z coordinate of the start point (mm)

params.name: x2
params.description: X coordinate of the end point (mm)

params.name: y2
params.description: Y coordinate of the end point (mm)

params.name: z2
params.description: Z coordinate of the end point (mm)

tools.name: cst_add_lumped_element
tools.description: Add a lumped R, L, C, or RLC element between two points. Value is in ohms for R, henries for L, farads for C.

params.name: name
params.description: Unique name for the lumped element

params.name: value
params.description: Element value (ohms for R, henries for L, farads for C)

params.name: x1
params.description: X coordinate of the first terminal (mm)

params.name: y1
params.description: Y coordinate of the first terminal (mm)

params.name: z1
params.description: Z coordinate of the first terminal (mm)

params.name: x2
params.description: X coordinate of the second terminal (mm)

params.name: y2
params.description: Y coordinate of the second terminal (mm)

params.name: z2
params.description: Z coordinate of the second terminal (mm)

tools.name: cst_add_plane_wave
tools.description: Add a plane wave excitation source. Defines an incident plane wave with given direction and polarization for scattering / RCS analysis.

params.name: theta
params.description: Elevation angle of incidence in degrees (0-180)

params.name: phi
params.description: Azimuth angle of incidence in degrees (0-360)

params.name: e_theta
params.description: Theta component of the polarization vector (default 1)

params.name: e_phi
params.description: Phi component of the polarization vector (default 0)

tools.name: cst_add_floquet_port
tools.description: Add a Floquet port for periodic structures such as frequency selective surfaces, metamaterials, and phased arrays.

params.name: orientation
params.description: Orientation of the Floquet port (zmin or zmax)

params.name: modes
params.description: Number of Floquet modes to include (default 2)

tools.name: cst_list_ports
tools.description: List all ports defined in the current CST project. Returns VBA to query port information, or a description in offline mode.

tools.name: cst_delete_port
tools.description: Delete a port by its port number.

tools.name: cst_add_multipin_port
tools.description: Add a waveguide port with multiple mode monitoring for higher-order mode analysis. Used for multimode waveguides, mode converters, and structures where higher-order propagating modes need to be captured.

params.name: orientation
params.description: Face of the bounding box where the port is placed

params.name: x_min
params.description: X-axis minimum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: x_max
params.description: X-axis maximum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: y_min
params.description: Y-axis minimum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: y_max
params.description: Y-axis maximum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: z_min
params.description: Z-axis minimum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: z_max
params.description: Z-axis maximum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

params.name: num_modes
params.description: Number of modes to monitor (1-10, default 1)

categories.blurb_en: Open/electric walls, background, symmetry, frequency range.
categories.blurb_tr: Açık/elektrik duvar, arka plan, simetri, frekans aralığı.

tools.name: cst_set_boundary
tools.description: Set boundary conditions for the simulation domain. Each face of the bounding box can be assigned an independent boundary type (open, electric, magnetic, periodic, etc.).

tools.name: cst_set_background
tools.description: Set the background material properties of the simulation domain. The background fills all space not occupied by defined solids.

params.name: epsilon
params.description: Relative permittivity (default 1.0, used when material is Normal)

params.name: mu
params.description: Relative permeability (default 1.0, used when material is Normal)

tools.name: cst_set_symmetry
tools.description: Set symmetry planes to reduce computation time. Each axis can be assigned electric or magnetic symmetry, or none. Requires the model geometry and excitation to be compatible with the chosen symmetry.

params.name: x_plane
params.description: Symmetry condition on the YZ plane (default none)

params.name: y_plane
params.description: Symmetry condition on the XZ plane (default none)

params.name: z_plane
params.description: Symmetry condition on the XY plane (default none)

tools.name: cst_set_frequency_range
tools.description: Set the simulation frequency range in GHz. This determines the bandwidth over which the solver computes results.

tools.name: cst_set_periodic_boundary
tools.description: Configure periodic boundary conditions with optional phase shift for unit cell simulation. Sets X and Y boundaries to periodic and configures the phase shift for infinite array, FSS, and metasurface analysis.

params.name: phase_x_deg
params.description: Phase shift in X direction in degrees (default 0)

params.name: phase_y_deg
params.description: Phase shift in Y direction in degrees (default 0)

tools.name: cst_set_floquet_port_advanced
tools.description: Configure advanced Floquet port settings for periodic structures. Controls the number of Floquet modes and scan angle for phased array element simulation and oblique incidence analysis.

categories.blurb_en: Mesh type, density, refinement, adaptive meshing.
categories.blurb_tr: Mesh tipi, yoğunluk, iyileştirme, adaptif mesh.

tools.name: cst_set_mesh_type
tools.description: Set the mesh type for the simulation. Hexahedral is used for time-domain, Tetrahedral for frequency-domain, Surface for integral-equation, and Hexahedral TLM for TLM solver.

tools.name: cst_set_mesh_density
tools.description: Set global mesh density parameters controlling automatic mesh generation. Higher cells_per_wavelength gives finer mesh and better accuracy at the cost of longer simulation time.

params.name: cells_per_wavelength
params.description: Number of mesh cells per wavelength (default 15)

params.name: min_cells
params.description: Minimum number of mesh steps across any structure (default 5)

params.name: ratio_limit
params.description: Maximum ratio between adjacent mesh cells (default 20)

tools.name: cst_add_mesh_refinement
tools.description: Add local mesh refinement to a specific solid. This creates finer mesh around critical geometry features like feed points, gaps, or thin layers.

params.name: solid
params.description: Solid name to refine mesh around

params.name: refinement_factor
params.description: Refinement factor — mesh cells are divided by this value (default 2.0)

tools.name: cst_set_adaptive_mesh
tools.description: Configure adaptive mesh refinement. When enabled, the solver runs multiple passes, refining the mesh in regions of high field gradient until the result converges within the specified threshold.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Enable or disable adaptive meshing (default true)

params.name: max_passes
params.description: Maximum number of adaptive mesh refinement passes (default 3)

params.name: threshold
params.description: Convergence threshold in dB — stop when S-parameter change is below this (default 0.02)

tools.name: cst_get_mesh_info
tools.description: Get current mesh statistics and settings. In connected mode this queries the live mesh data; in offline mode it returns the VBA to retrieve mesh info.

tools.name: cst_get_mesh_quality
tools.description: Extract mesh quality metrics including total cells, aspect ratios, and cells per wavelength. In connected mode this queries actual mesh statistics; in offline mode it describes what metrics would be returned.

tools.name: cst_set_pml_properties
tools.description: Configure PML (Perfectly Matched Layer) absorbing boundary properties. Controls the number of absorbing layers and the target reflection level for fine-tuning radiation boundary accuracy.

params.name: reflection_level_db
params.description: Target reflection level in dB (-80 to -20, default -40)

tools.name: cst_add_fixpoint_mesh
tools.description: Add a fixed mesh point at specific coordinates for precise field sampling. Ensures the mesh contains a node exactly at the specified location for accurate field probing.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional name for the fixed mesh point

categories.blurb_en: Time domain, frequency domain, eigenmode, IE…
categories.blurb_tr: Zaman alanı, frekans alanı, özmod, IE…

tools.name: cst_configure_time_domain_solver
tools.description: Configure the time domain (transient) solver. This is CST's flagship solver for broadband simulations — it excites the structure with a pulse and computes S-parameters, fields, and farfield across the entire frequency range in a single run.

params.name: accuracy
params.description: Accuracy level in dB — solver stops when energy has decayed to this level (default -40)

params.name: max_time_steps
params.description: Maximum number of time steps; 0 means automatic (default 0)

params.name: normalize_to_fixed_impedance
params.description: Normalize S-parameters to a fixed reference impedance (default true)

params.name: fixed_impedance
params.description: Reference impedance in ohms when normalization is enabled (default 50)

tools.name: cst_configure_frequency_domain_solver
tools.description: Configure the frequency domain solver. Best for narrowband problems, resonant structures, and when field distributions at specific frequencies are needed. Supports interpolated, discrete, and general-purpose sweep types.

tools.name: cst_configure_eigenmode_solver
tools.description: Configure the eigenmode solver. Computes resonant frequencies and field distributions of cavity structures. Used for filter design, resonator characterization, and Q-factor extraction.

params.name: f_min
params.description: Lower frequency bound in GHz — modes below this are skipped (default 0)

tools.name: cst_configure_integral_equation_solver
tools.description: Configure the integral equation (IE) solver. Best for electrically large, open-boundary problems like antenna placement on vehicles, RCS computation, and EMC/EMI analysis where volume meshing would be impractical.

tools.name: cst_get_solver_info
tools.description: Get current solver configuration and status. In connected mode this queries the active solver settings; in offline mode it describes expected parameters.

tools.name: cst_configure_eigenmode_advanced
tools.description: Advanced eigenmode solver configuration for higher-order modes. Use this for waveguide mode analysis, cavity resonator design, and filter characterization where fine control over mode count, frequency targeting, and solver order is needed.

params.name: num_modes
params.description: Number of eigenmodes to compute (1-50, default 5)

params.name: frequency_estimate_ghz
params.description: Frequency estimate in GHz to target specific modes (optional)

tools.name: cst_configure_ie_solver_advanced
tools.description: Advanced Integral Equation solver configuration for electrically large structures. Provides control over preconditioner, MLFMM acceleration, and low-frequency stabilization for installed antenna performance and large-platform RCS analysis.

params.name: low_frequency_stabilization
params.description: Enable low-frequency stabilization for broadband problems (default false)

params.name: mlfmm
params.description: Enable Multi-Level Fast Multipole Method for large problems (default true)

tools.name: cst_configure_multilayer_solver
tools.description: Configure the solver for planar multilayer structures. Optimised for antenna-on-PCB, frequency selective surfaces (FSS), and radome analysis using the frequency domain solver with multilayer-specific settings.

categories.blurb_en: Run, pause, resume, stop simulations.
categories.blurb_tr: Simülasyonu çalıştır, duraklat, sürdür, durdur.

tools.name: cst_run_simulation
tools.description: Start a CST simulation with the current solver settings. This is a blocking call that waits for the simulation to complete. Use cst_run_simulation_async for long-running simulations.

params.name: solver_type
params.description: Solver type to use. If omitted, the currently configured solver is used. Options: 'Time Domain', 'Frequency Domain', 'Eigenmode', 'Integral Equation'.

tools.name: cst_run_simulation_async
tools.description: Start a CST simulation asynchronously (non-blocking). The simulation launches and control returns immediately. Use cst_get_simulation_status to monitor progress.

params.name: solver_type
params.description: Solver type to use. If omitted, the currently configured solver is used. Options: 'Time Domain', 'Frequency Domain', 'Eigenmode', 'Integral Equation'.

tools.name: cst_get_simulation_status
tools.description: Check the status and progress of a running CST simulation. Returns information such as whether a simulation is running, progress percentage, mesh cell count, and current time step.

tools.name: cst_pause_simulation
tools.description: Pause a currently running CST simulation. The simulation can be resumed later with cst_resume_simulation.

tools.name: cst_resume_simulation
tools.description: Resume a previously paused CST simulation. Use after cst_pause_simulation to continue from where it stopped.

tools.name: cst_stop_simulation
tools.description: Stop and abort a running CST simulation. Unlike pause, a stopped simulation cannot be resumed — it must be restarted from the beginning.

categories.blurb_en: S-parameters, far-field, VSWR, gain, Smith, bandwidth…
categories.blurb_tr: S-parametreleri, uzak alan, VSWR, kazanç, Smith, bant…

tools.name: cst_get_s_parameters
tools.description: Extract S-parameter results from a completed CST simulation. Returns S-parameter data (magnitude, phase, real/imaginary) for the specified port pair. In connected mode reads directly from the result tree; in offline mode returns VBA scripts and explains the CST result tree structure.

params.name: format
params.description: Output format for S-parameter data. 'db' = magnitude in dB, 'mag' = linear magnitude, 'real_imag' = real and imaginary parts, 'phase' = phase in degrees.

tools.name: cst_get_farfield
tools.description: Get far-field radiation pattern results from a completed CST simulation at a specific frequency. Returns gain, directivity, radiation efficiency, and beam widths. Requires a farfield monitor at the specified frequency.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract the far-field pattern.

params.name: monitor_name
params.description: Name of the far-field monitor. If omitted, defaults to 'farfield (f=<frequency>)' which is the CST auto-generated name.

tools.name: cst_add_field_monitor
tools.description: Add a field monitor at a specific frequency to the CST project. Field monitors must be defined before running a simulation to capture field distributions, far-field patterns, surface currents, or power flow at the desired frequency.

params.name: monitor_type
params.description: Type of field monitor to add. Options: Efield (electric field), Hfield (magnetic field), Powerflow (Poynting vector), Current (volume current), Powerloss (loss density), Farfield (radiation pattern), Surfacecurrent (surface current density).

params.name: name
params.description: Custom name for the monitor. If omitted, a name is auto-generated from the type and frequency, e.g. 'e-field (f=2.45)'.

tools.name: cst_get_impedance
tools.description: Get input impedance (Z-parameters) for a port from a completed CST simulation. Returns real and imaginary impedance vs frequency. Useful for matching network design and feed optimization.

params.name: port
params.description: Port number to extract impedance for.

tools.name: cst_get_vswr
tools.description: Get Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) for a port from a completed CST simulation. VSWR indicates impedance matching quality: 1.0 is perfect match, <2.0 is generally acceptable. Can also be computed from S11: VSWR = (1+|S11|)/(1-|S11|).

params.name: port
params.description: Port number to extract VSWR for.

tools.name: cst_get_gain
tools.description: Get antenna gain at a specific frequency from a completed CST simulation. Returns peak gain in dBi and the direction (theta, phi) of maximum gain. Requires a farfield monitor at the specified frequency.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract gain.

tools.name: cst_get_efficiency
tools.description: Get antenna radiation efficiency from a completed CST simulation at a specific frequency. Returns total efficiency (including mismatch), radiation efficiency (excluding mismatch), and mismatch loss in dB.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract efficiency.

tools.name: cst_list_results
tools.description: List all available results in the CST result tree. Optionally specify a subtree path to narrow the listing. Useful for discovering what simulation results are available before extracting specific data.

params.name: tree_path
params.description: Result tree path to list, e.g. '1D Results', '1D Results\S-Parameters', 'Farfields', '2D/3D Results'. Omit to list top-level result categories.

tools.name: cst_export_result
tools.description: Export a simulation result to a file (CSV, Touchstone, or text). Specify the result tree path and desired output format. Useful for post-processing results in external tools like MATLAB or Python.

params.name: result_path
params.description: CST result tree path to export, e.g. '1D Results\S-Parameters\S1,1' or 'Farfields\farfield (f=2.45)'.

params.name: output_file
params.description: Full file path for the exported file.

params.name: format
params.description: Export file format. 'csv' for comma-separated values, 'touchstone' for Touchstone/SnP format (S-parameters only), 'txt' for space-separated text.

tools.name: cst_get_result_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of all key simulation results from a completed CST simulation. Returns an overview of S-parameters, gain, efficiency, and impedance. Useful for a quick design evaluation without querying each result type individually.

tools.name: cst_get_s_parameter_phase
tools.description: Extract S-parameter phase response from a completed CST simulation. Returns the phase of the specified S-parameter vs frequency. Optionally unwraps the phase to remove 360-degree discontinuities. Useful for group delay analysis and phase-matching designs.

params.name: unwrap
params.description: If true, unwrap the phase to remove 360-degree jumps. Useful for group delay computation.

tools.name: cst_get_group_delay
tools.description: Compute group delay from S-parameter phase for a port pair. Group delay is defined as tau = -d(phase)/d(2*pi*f) and represents the signal propagation delay through the device. Useful for UWB antenna and filter characterization.

tools.name: cst_get_pattern_cut
tools.description: Extract an E-plane, H-plane, or custom radiation pattern cut from a completed CST simulation at a specific frequency. Returns gain vs angle for the selected plane. Requires a farfield monitor at the specified frequency.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract the pattern cut.

params.name: plane
params.description: Pattern cut plane. 'E' for E-plane (phi=0), 'H' for H-plane (phi=90), 'custom' for arbitrary cut.

params.name: phi_cut
params.description: Phi angle (degrees) for custom plane cut. Only used when plane='custom'. Default 0.

params.name: theta_cut
params.description: Theta angle (degrees) for custom plane cut. Only used when plane='custom'. Default 90.

tools.name: cst_get_cross_polarization
tools.description: Extract cross-polarization level and cross-polarization discrimination (XPD) from a completed CST simulation. Supports Ludwig-3, Ludwig-2, and circular polarization definitions. Requires a farfield monitor at the specified frequency.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract cross-polarization.

params.name: definition
params.description: Polarization definition to use. 'Ludwig3' is the most common for linear polarization, 'Ludwig2' for aperture antennas, 'circular' for CP antennas.

tools.name: cst_get_axial_ratio
tools.description: Extract axial ratio for circularly polarized antennas from a completed CST simulation. Axial ratio (AR) indicates the quality of circular polarization: AR=0 dB is perfect CP, AR<3 dB is acceptable. Can plot AR vs angle or vs frequency.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract axial ratio.

params.name: mode
params.description: 'vs_angle' to plot AR vs theta at fixed frequency, 'vs_frequency' to plot AR vs frequency at fixed angle.

params.name: theta_cut
params.description: Theta angle (degrees) for the observation direction.

params.name: phi_cut
params.description: Phi angle (degrees) for the observation direction.

tools.name: cst_get_surface_current
tools.description: Extract surface current density distribution from a completed CST simulation at a specific frequency. Useful for understanding current flow on antenna structures and identifying hot spots. Requires a surface current monitor at the specified frequency.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract surface current.

params.name: component
params.description: Optional: specific component to extract current for. If omitted, extracts for all components.

tools.name: cst_get_efficiency_breakdown
tools.description: Get a detailed efficiency breakdown with loss budget from a completed CST simulation. Returns radiation efficiency, total efficiency, and individual loss contributions (mismatch, conductor, dielectric). Useful for identifying dominant loss mechanisms in antenna designs.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract efficiency breakdown.

tools.name: cst_get_time_domain_signal
tools.description: Extract time-domain port signal waveforms from a completed CST time-domain simulation. Returns incident, reflected, or transmitted signal vs time. Useful for UWB pulse analysis, time-domain reflectometry, and transient response evaluation.

params.name: signal_type
params.description: 'incident' for the excitation signal at the port, 'reflected' for the reflected signal, 'transmitted' for the signal received at another port.

params.name: port_out
params.description: Output port number (only used when signal_type='transmitted'). Specifies which port receives the transmitted signal.

tools.name: cst_get_smith_chart_data
tools.description: Extract Smith chart formatted impedance data from a completed CST simulation. Computes normalized impedance from S11 reflection coefficient: Z = Z0*(1+S11)/(1-S11). Returns real and imaginary parts of the normalized impedance for Smith chart plotting.

params.name: port
params.description: Port number to extract Smith chart data for.

params.name: z0
params.description: Reference impedance in Ohms for normalization. Typically 50 Ohms for most RF systems.

tools.name: cst_get_bandwidth
tools.description: Calculate impedance bandwidth from S-parameter results. Finds the frequency range where S11 (or VSWR) meets the specified threshold. Returns center frequency, bandwidth in MHz, and fractional bandwidth percentage.

params.name: port
params.description: Port number to compute bandwidth for.

params.name: threshold_db
params.description: S11 threshold in dB for bandwidth computation. Common values: -10 dB (VSWR 2:1), -6 dB (VSWR 3:1), -15 dB (VSWR 1.4:1).

params.name: criterion
params.description: 'S11' to use return loss threshold, 'VSWR' to use VSWR threshold.

tools.name: cst_get_radiation_pattern_3d
tools.description: Export full 3D radiation pattern data from a completed CST simulation at a specific frequency. Returns gain values over the full sphere in spherical or Cartesian coordinates. Useful for antenna pattern visualization and integration with external tools. Requires a farfield monitor at the specified frequency.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract the 3D pattern.

params.name: resolution_deg
params.description: Angular resolution in degrees for the exported pattern. Lower values give finer resolution but larger data. Typical values: 1, 2, 5, 10.

params.name: coordinate
params.description: 'spherical' for (theta, phi, gain) output, 'cartesian' for (x, y, z, gain) output.

tools.name: cst_get_current_distribution
tools.description: Extract volume current distribution from a completed CST simulation at a specific frequency. Complements surface current extraction by providing current density inside dielectric or lossy volumes. Requires a current density monitor at the specified frequency.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz at which to extract current distribution.

params.name: component
params.description: Optional: specific component to extract current for. If omitted, extracts for all components.

categories.blurb_en: CAD and Touchstone import/export, far-field export.
categories.blurb_tr: CAD ve Touchstone içe/dışa aktarma, farfield export.

tools.name: cst_import_cad
tools.description: Import a CAD file into CST Studio. Supports STEP (.stp/.step), IGES (.igs/.iges), STL (.stl), SAT/ACIS (.sat), DXF (.dxf), and OBJ (.obj) formats.

params.name: file_path
params.description: Full path to the CAD file to import.

params.name: format
params.description: CAD file format: stp (STEP), igs (IGES), stl, sat (ACIS), dxf, obj.

params.name: component
params.description: Target component name for the imported geometry.

tools.name: cst_export_cad
tools.description: Export the current CST model (or a specific component) to a CAD format. Supports STL, SAT/ACIS, STEP, IGES, OBJ, and NASTRAN.

params.name: file_path
params.description: Destination file path for the exported CAD file.

params.name: format
params.description: Export format: stl, sat, stp (STEP), igs (IGES), obj, nas (NASTRAN).

params.name: component
params.description: Optional component name to export. If omitted, the entire model is exported.

tools.name: cst_import_touchstone
tools.description: Import a Touchstone S-parameter file (.s1p, .s2p, .snp) into CST Studio for use as a reference or circuit element.

params.name: file_path
params.description: Full path to the Touchstone file (.s1p, .s2p, etc.).

params.name: port_number
params.description: Port number to associate the imported data with.

tools.name: cst_export_touchstone
tools.description: Export S-parameter simulation results to a Touchstone file. Requires a completed simulation with S-parameter data.

params.name: file_path
params.description: Destination file path for the Touchstone file.

tools.name: cst_export_farfield
tools.description: Export far-field radiation pattern data to a file. Requires a completed simulation with far-field monitor results.

params.name: file_path
params.description: Destination file path for the far-field data.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency in GHz for the far-field data to export.

params.name: format
params.description: Export format: csv (comma-separated), ffs (CST far-field source), nsf (NSI near-to-far-field).

categories.blurb_en: Design parameters, sweeps, optimizers, sensitivity, yield.
categories.blurb_tr: Tasarım parametreleri, tarama, optimizer, hassasiyet, yield.

tools.name: cst_set_parameter
tools.description: Set or create a design parameter in CST Studio. Parameters can hold numeric values or string expressions referencing other parameters.

params.name: value
params.description: Parameter value — a number (e.g. 10.5) or a string expression referencing other parameters (e.g. 'patch_length / 2').

params.name: description
params.description: Optional human-readable description of the parameter.

tools.name: cst_get_parameter
tools.description: Get the current value of a design parameter. Returns both the stored expression and the evaluated numeric value.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the parameter to retrieve.

tools.name: cst_list_parameters
tools.description: List all design parameters in the current CST project with their names, expressions, and evaluated numeric values.

tools.name: cst_delete_parameter
tools.description: Delete a design parameter from the CST project. The parameter must not be referenced by other parameters or geometry.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the parameter to delete.

tools.name: cst_parameter_sweep
tools.description: Set up a parameter sweep in CST Studio. The sweep runs the simulation multiple times, varying the specified parameter across a range of values.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Name of the parameter to sweep.

params.name: start
params.description: Start value of the sweep range.

params.name: stop
params.description: Stop value of the sweep range.

params.name: steps
params.description: Number of steps in the sweep (minimum 2).

params.name: simulation_type
params.description: Solver type for the sweep. Defaults to Transient.

tools.name: cst_optimizer
tools.description: Set up an optimization in CST Studio. Define a goal (minimize, maximize, or target a specific value for a result), specify which parameters to vary with their bounds, and choose an optimization algorithm.

params.name: goal_value
params.description: Target value for 'target' goal type. Ignored for minimize/maximize.

params.name: result_path
params.description: Result tree path to optimize, e.g. '1D Results\S-Parameters\S1,1' or '1D Results\S-Parameters\S2,1'.

params.name: parameters
params.description: List of parameters to optimize with their min/max bounds.

tools.name: cst_multi_objective_optimizer
tools.description: Set up a multi-objective optimization with weighted goals and optional constraints. Supports Pareto-front exploration using Genetic Algorithm or Particle Swarm methods.

params.name: goals
params.description: List of optimization goals with weights.

params.name: method
params.description: Optimization method (GA or PSO recommended for multi-objective).

tools.name: cst_sensitivity_analysis
tools.description: Set up a one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis to rank parameters by their impact on a result. Varies each parameter individually while keeping others at nominal values.

tools.name: cst_yield_analysis
tools.description: Set up a Monte Carlo yield analysis to estimate manufacturing yield. Randomly varies parameters according to their tolerances and evaluates pass/fail criteria.

tools.name: cst_constrained_optimizer
tools.description: Single-objective optimization with explicit inequality constraints. Example: minimize S11 subject to gain > 8 dBi and bandwidth > 100 MHz.

tools.name: cst_parameter_interpolation
tools.description: Interpolate results between parameter sweep data points to estimate performance at a specific parameter value without running a new simulation.

params.name: target_value
params.description: Parameter value at which to interpolate results.

categories.blurb_en: Goal-driven evaluation and refinement helpers.
categories.blurb_tr: Hedef odaklı değerlendirme ve iyileştirme yardımcıları.

tools.name: cst_evaluate_antenna
tools.description: Evaluate current antenna simulation results against performance goals. Exports S-parameter data and checks VSWR (or return loss) against per-band targets. Read-only — does not modify the model. Returns pass/fail per band, worst VSWR, and detected resonances.

tools.name: cst_analyze_impedance
tools.description: Analyze antenna impedance match quality across frequency bands using S-parameter data. Exports S11 from a completed simulation, computes VSWR and return loss per frequency point, detects resonances, and provides resonance-based design recommendations (e.g. shift resonance up/down, widen bandwidth). Returns per-band worst/best VSWR, match quality classification, nearest resonance info, and actionable design guidance. Read-only — does not modify the model.

params.name: bands
params.description: Frequency bands to analyze impedance for.

params.name: sample_frequencies_ghz
params.description: Specific frequencies (GHz) to report detailed impedance. If omitted, band edges and center are used.

tools.name: cst_refine_antenna
tools.description: Run an automated Nelder-Mead optimization loop to tune CST design parameters toward VSWR goals across specified frequency bands. Each iteration sets parameters, runs the solver, exports S11, and evaluates against targets. Uses silent VBA execution to avoid history bloat. Applies the best parameters permanently at the end. Connected mode only — requires a live CST session with a solvable project.

params.name: parameters
params.description: Parameters to optimize with initial values and bounds.

categories.blurb_en: Logs, delete results, auto-dismiss blocking CST dialogs.
categories.blurb_tr: Loglar, sonuç silme, engelleyen CST diyaloglarını kapatma.

tools.name: cst_delete_results
tools.description: Delete simulation results from the current CST project. This prevents the 'Results May Get Incompatible With Model' dialog that blocks automation when modifying a model with existing results. Call before making parameter or geometry changes on a project that has been solved.

tools.name: cst_read_project_log
tools.description: Read solver log files and project status information from the current CST project. Returns solver running state and the contents of the most recent log file. Useful for diagnosing solver errors, checking simulation progress, and understanding what happened during a failed run.

tools.name: cst_dismiss_dialogs
tools.description: Find and dismiss any visible CST dialog windows (error popups, 'Results Incompatible' dialogs, solver warnings). Returns the title and text content of each dialog before dismissing it. Use this to unblock CST when a modal dialog is preventing further automation. Uses Win32 API on Windows.

params.name: read_only
params.description: If true, only read dialog content without dismissing. Default: false (read and dismiss).

tools.name: cst_start_dialog_watcher
tools.description: Start a background thread that automatically detects and dismisses CST dialog windows as they appear. Essential for long-running operations like optimization loops where dialogs would otherwise block execution. The watcher logs every dialog it dismisses — retrieve the log with cst_stop_dialog_watcher.

tools.name: cst_stop_dialog_watcher
tools.description: Stop the background dialog watcher and return its log of all dialogs that were auto-dismissed. Use after completing an operation that required the watcher.

categories.blurb_en: Parametric antennas: patch, dipole, horn, Yagi, helix…
categories.blurb_tr: Parametrik antenler: patch, dipole, horn, Yagi, helix…

tools.name: cst_antenna_patch
tools.description: Create a rectangular microstrip patch antenna with calculated dimensions for a target frequency. Supports inset, microstrip, and probe feed types. Generates substrate, ground plane, patch, feed structure, waveguide port, boundaries, and field monitors.

params.name: ground_size_factor
params.description: Ground plane size = factor * patch size (default 2.0)

tools.name: cst_antenna_dipole
tools.description: Create a half-wave dipole antenna at a target frequency. Generates two wire arms with a discrete port at the feed gap.

tools.name: cst_antenna_monopole
tools.description: Create a quarter-wave monopole antenna over a ground plane. Generates a vertical wire element, ground plane, and feed port.

params.name: ground_radius_mm
params.description: Ground plane radius in mm (auto-calculated if omitted)

tools.name: cst_antenna_horn
tools.description: Create a pyramidal horn antenna for a target frequency and gain. Generates the waveguide section, flared horn, and waveguide port.

params.name: a
params.description: Waveguide broad-wall dimension in mm (auto-calculated if omitted)

params.name: b
params.description: Waveguide narrow-wall dimension in mm (auto-calculated if omitted)

tools.name: cst_antenna_yagi
tools.description: Create a Yagi-Uda antenna with a reflector, driven element, and configurable number of directors. Generates wire elements and a discrete port feed.

tools.name: cst_antenna_helix
tools.description: Create an axial-mode helical antenna for circular polarization. Generates helix coil, ground plane, and feed.

tools.name: cst_antenna_vivaldi
tools.description: Create a Vivaldi (tapered slot) antenna on a dielectric substrate. Generates substrate, exponential taper metallisation, and feed.

tools.name: cst_antenna_slot
tools.description: Create a slot antenna in a ground plane. Generates the ground plane with a resonant slot and microstrip feed.

params.name: slot_width_mm
params.description: Slot width in mm (auto-calculated if omitted)

tools.name: cst_antenna_ifa
tools.description: Create an Inverted-F antenna (IFA) suitable for mobile devices. Generates ground plane, radiating arm, shorting pin, and feed.

tools.name: cst_antenna_pifa
tools.description: Create a Planar Inverted-F Antenna (PIFA) for compact wireless devices. Generates ground plane, top patch, shorting wall, and feed.

params.name: patch_width_mm
params.description: Patch width in mm (auto-calculated if omitted)

tools.name: cst_antenna_spiral
tools.description: Create a wideband Archimedean spiral antenna. Generates two spiral arms with a discrete port feed at the center.

params.name: freq_low_ghz
params.description: Low end of operating band in GHz

params.name: freq_high_ghz
params.description: High end of operating band in GHz

tools.name: cst_antenna_bowtie
tools.description: Create a planar bowtie antenna. Generates two triangular arms with a discrete port at the feed gap.

params.name: flare_angle
params.description: Flare half-angle of each arm in degrees (default 60)

params.name: arm_length_mm
params.description: Arm length in mm (auto-calculated from frequency if omitted)

tools.name: cst_list_antenna_templates
tools.description: List all available parametric antenna templates with descriptions and typical use cases. No arguments required.

categories.blurb_en: Linear/planar/circular arrays, beam steering, taper.
categories.blurb_tr: Doğrusal/düzlemsel/dairesel dizi, hüzme yönlendirme, taper.

tools.name: cst_array_linear
tools.description: Create a linear antenna array by replicating an element along a chosen axis. Uses Transform.Translate to produce copies named Element_1 through Element_N.

params.name: element_component
params.description: Component name of the element to replicate (default Antenna)

params.name: frequency_ghz
params.description: Design frequency in GHz (for wavelength reference)

tools.name: cst_array_planar
tools.description: Create a 2D planar antenna array with rectangular or triangular lattice. Replicates an element in X and Y using Transform.Translate.

params.name: spacing_x_mm
params.description: Inter-element spacing along X in mm

params.name: spacing_y_mm
params.description: Inter-element spacing along Y in mm

params.name: element_component
params.description: Component name of the element to replicate (default Antenna)

params.name: frequency_ghz
params.description: Design frequency in GHz (for wavelength reference)

tools.name: cst_array_circular
tools.description: Create a circular antenna array by placing elements at equal angular intervals around a circle of given radius.

params.name: element_component
params.description: Component name of the element to replicate (default Antenna)

params.name: frequency_ghz
params.description: Design frequency in GHz (for wavelength reference)

tools.name: cst_array_compute_factor
tools.description: Compute the array factor analytically for a linear or planar array. Returns AF(theta) in dB, half-power beamwidth, first null beamwidth, peak sidelobe level, and directivity.

params.name: scan_angle_deg
params.description: Scan angle in degrees from broadside (default 0)

tools.name: cst_array_beam_steering
tools.description: Calculate progressive phase weights to steer the main beam to a specified angle. Returns phase weights and VBA to set port phases in CST.

params.name: scan_theta_deg
params.description: Desired scan angle theta in degrees from broadside

params.name: scan_phi_deg
params.description: Desired scan angle phi in degrees (default 0)

tools.name: cst_array_taper_design
tools.description: Design amplitude taper weights for sidelobe control. Supports uniform, cosine, Hamming, Hanning, Blackman, Taylor, and Chebyshev window functions.

params.name: sidelobe_level_db
params.description: Desired peak sidelobe level in dB (negative, default -25). Used for Taylor and Chebyshev only.

tools.name: cst_array_grating_lobe_analysis
tools.description: Analyse whether grating lobes exist for a given element spacing and maximum scan angle. Returns safe spacing and grating lobe angles.

params.name: max_scan_angle_deg
params.description: Maximum scan angle from broadside in degrees (default 60)

tools.name: cst_array_mutual_coupling
tools.description: Set up a multi-port S-parameter simulation in CST for mutual coupling extraction between array elements.

params.name: num_ports
params.description: Total number of ports in the array

categories.blurb_en: Stackups, traces, vias, ground planes, Gerber import.
categories.blurb_tr: Stackup, hat, via, toprak düzlemi, Gerber import.

tools.name: cst_pcb_create_stackup
tools.description: Create a PCB layer stackup in CST Studio. Generates brick geometry for each layer (signal, ground, power, dielectric) positioned vertically with correct materials. Returns total thickness and layer positions.

params.name: layers
params.description: Ordered list of layers from top to bottom. Example 4-layer: signal-dielectric-ground-dielectric(core)-power-dielectric-signal

tools.name: cst_pcb_create_trace
tools.description: Create a PCB trace (microstrip, stripline, coplanar waveguide, or grounded CPW) in CST Studio. Optionally calculates trace width from a target impedance using Hammerstad-Jensen (microstrip) or Cohn (stripline) formulas.

params.name: width_mm
params.description: Trace width in mm. If impedance_target is specified, this is ignored and the width is calculated automatically.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer name where the trace is placed (e.g. 'Top')

params.name: direction
params.description: Trace direction: 'x' for +X, 'y' for +Y, or angle in degrees from +X axis (e.g. '45')

params.name: impedance_target
params.description: Target characteristic impedance in ohms. When specified, trace width is auto-calculated. Requires substrate_height_mm and epsilon_r.

params.name: substrate_height_mm
params.description: Substrate height between trace and reference plane (mm). Required when impedance_target is given.

params.name: epsilon_r
params.description: Substrate relative permittivity. Required when impedance_target is given.

params.name: z_position
params.description: Z position of the trace bottom surface in mm. If omitted, defaults to 0 (top surface of the board).

tools.name: cst_pcb_create_via
tools.description: Create a PCB via (through, blind, or buried) in CST Studio. Generates the cylindrical via barrel with specified drill and pad dimensions. Pad and antipad diameters are validated and reported but the geometry covers the barrel only; add pads separately if needed.

params.name: antipad_diameter_mm
params.description: Antipad (clearance) diameter in plane layers in mm

params.name: start_z
params.description: Z coordinate of the via start (top) in mm

params.name: end_z
params.description: Z coordinate of the via end (bottom) in mm

params.name: name
params.description: Via name for the CST model (auto-generated if omitted)

tools.name: cst_pcb_create_ground_plane
tools.description: Create a ground or power plane with optional cutouts (split planes, isolation slots) in CST Studio. Generates a solid copper brick and subtracts cutout regions.

params.name: z_position
params.description: Z position of the plane bottom surface in mm

params.name: cutouts
params.description: Optional list of rectangular cutout regions

tools.name: cst_pcb_import_gerber
tools.description: Import a Gerber/ODB++/DXF file for PCB analysis in CST Studio. Generates VBA for the CST Gerber import wizard. In offline mode, explains the import process and required settings.

params.name: file_path
params.description: Path to the Gerber file (.gbr, .ger, .gtl, .gbl, etc.)

params.name: layer_name
params.description: Target layer name in the CST model

tools.name: cst_pcb_list_stackup_templates
tools.description: List predefined PCB stackup templates with complete layer definitions. Includes standard 2/4/6-layer FR-4 and RF-grade Rogers stackups. Use the returned layer data directly with cst_pcb_create_stackup.

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional filter string to match template names (e.g. '4-layer', 'Rogers', 'RF'). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: cst_pcb_differential_pair
tools.description: Create a differential pair of PCB traces in CST Studio. Generates two parallel bricks separated by a gap and calculates the differential impedance using coupled-line theory (Zdiff = 2*Z0*(1-k)).

params.name: name
params.description: Base name for the differential pair (e.g. 'USB_DP')

params.name: trace_width_mm
params.description: Width of each trace in mm

params.name: gap_mm
params.description: Gap between the two traces in mm

params.name: height_mm
params.description: Substrate height to reference plane in mm

params.name: x_start
params.description: X coordinate of the pair center start in mm

params.name: y_start
params.description: Y coordinate of the pair center start in mm

tools.name: cst_pcb_via_model
tools.description: Create a detailed PCB via model in CST Studio with parasitic inductance and capacitance estimates. Uses the Goldfarb model for via inductance and a simplified capacitance formula.

params.name: name
params.description: Via name for the CST model

tools.name: cst_pcb_via_fence
tools.description: Create a row (or multiple rows) of vias along a path for isolation or Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) construction. Generates an array of cylinders from start to end point with specified spacing.

params.name: name
params.description: Base name for the via fence

params.name: x_start
params.description: X coordinate of the fence start in mm

params.name: y_start
params.description: Y coordinate of the fence start in mm

params.name: x_end
params.description: X coordinate of the fence end in mm

params.name: y_end
params.description: Y coordinate of the fence end in mm

params.name: via_spacing_mm
params.description: Center-to-center spacing between vias in mm

params.name: row_offset_mm
params.description: Lateral offset between rows for staggering in mm

tools.name: cst_pcb_cpw_transition
tools.description: Create a coplanar waveguide (CPW) to microstrip transition in CST Studio. Generates a tapered geometry that linearly tapers the center conductor width and gap over the transition length. Calculates CPW and microstrip impedances.

params.name: cpw_width_mm
params.description: CPW center conductor width in mm

params.name: microstrip_width_mm
params.description: Microstrip trace width at the end of the transition in mm

params.name: transition_length_mm
params.description: Length of the tapered transition in mm

params.name: height_mm
params.description: Substrate height to reference plane in mm

tools.name: cst_pcb_calculate_coupling
tools.description: Calculate electromagnetic coupling between parallel PCB traces. Computes even/odd mode impedances, coupling coefficient, and near-end/far-end crosstalk estimates using coupled microstrip formulas. Pure calculation — no VBA or CST geometry is generated.

params.name: trace_width_mm
params.description: Width of each trace in mm

params.name: separation_mm
params.description: Edge-to-edge separation between traces in mm

params.name: height_mm
params.description: Substrate height to reference plane in mm

tools.name: cst_pcb_siw_waveguide
tools.description: Create a Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) in CST Studio. Generates top and bottom copper planes with two rows of via fences forming the waveguide sidewalls. Calculates effective width, cutoff frequency, and guided wavelength using Cassivi et al. formulas.

params.name: width_mm
params.description: SIW width (center-to-center of via rows) in mm

params.name: via_pitch_mm
params.description: Center-to-center via spacing along the length in mm

params.name: x_start
params.description: X coordinate of the SIW start in mm

params.name: y_start
params.description: Y coordinate of the SIW start in mm

categories.blurb_en: L / Pi / T networks, stubs, quarter-wave, Smith transforms.
categories.blurb_tr: L / Pi / T ağları, stub, çeyrek dalga, Smith dönüşümleri.

tools.name: cst_matching_l_network
tools.description: Design an L-section impedance matching network. Computes inductor and capacitor values for matching a source impedance to a load impedance at a given frequency. Supports lowpass and highpass topologies. Pure Python computation — no CST connection needed.

tools.name: cst_matching_pi_network
tools.description: Design a Pi-section impedance matching network (C-L-C or L-C-L). Uses two back-to-back L-sections via a virtual resistance for controllable Q factor. Pure Python computation.

params.name: q_factor
params.description: Desired loaded Q factor. Must be > sqrt(R_large/R_small - 1). If omitted, a default Q is chosen automatically.

tools.name: cst_matching_t_network
tools.description: Design a T-section impedance matching network (L-C-L). Dual of Pi-network, uses two back-to-back L-sections. Pure Python computation.

params.name: q_factor
params.description: Desired loaded Q factor. Must be > sqrt(R_large/R_small - 1). If omitted, a default Q is chosen automatically.

tools.name: cst_matching_stub
tools.description: Design a single-stub impedance matching network. Computes the stub length and distance from the load using Smith chart transmission-line matching. Pure Python computation.

tools.name: cst_matching_quarter_wave
tools.description: Design a quarter-wave transformer matching network. Supports single and multi-section designs with maximally flat (binomial) or Chebyshev impedance profiles. Pure Python computation.

tools.name: cst_matching_create_lumped
tools.description: Generate CST VBA code to create a lumped-element matching network. Each component (inductor, capacitor, resistor) is placed as a CST LumpedElement with specified series/shunt connection.

params.name: components
params.description: List of lumped components in the network (ordered source to load)

tools.name: cst_impedance_smith_transform
tools.description: Apply a reactive element transformation to an impedance on the Smith chart. Supports series L/C, shunt L/C, and transmission line operations. Returns transformed impedance, reflection coefficient, and VSWR. Pure Python computation.

params.name: value
params.description: Component value: L in nH, C in pF, or transmission line electrical length in degrees

tools.name: cst_matching_microstrip_impedance
tools.description: Calculate microstrip transmission line characteristic impedance from physical dimensions using the Hammerstad-Jensen model with optional Kirschning-Jansen frequency dispersion correction. Pure Python computation.

params.name: frequency_ghz
params.description: Frequency in GHz for dispersion correction (optional)

params.name: thickness_mm
params.description: Conductor thickness in mm (default 0.035 = 1 oz copper)

categories.blurb_en: Raw VBA execution and built-in VBA object reference.
categories.blurb_tr: Ham VBA çalıştırma ve yerleşik VBA nesne referansı.

tools.name: cst_execute_vba
tools.description: Execute raw VBA code in CST Studio Suite. The code is validated for safety (shell access, file I/O, and external process execution are blocked). In connected mode the code runs directly; in offline mode the validated script is returned for manual execution.

params.name: code
params.description: VBA code to execute in CST Studio. Must not contain shell commands, file I/O, or external process calls.

tools.name: cst_vba_help
tools.description: Get VBA reference documentation for a CST Studio object. Returns the object description and a list of its common methods and properties.

params.name: object_name
params.description: Name of the CST VBA object to look up, e.g. 'Brick', 'Solver', 'Material', 'Port', 'Mesh', 'FarfieldPlot'.

tools.name: cst_list_vba_objects
tools.description: List available CST Studio VBA objects, optionally filtered by category. Returns object names with brief descriptions.

params.name: category
params.description: Optional category filter. If omitted, all categories are returned.

vba_reference_note.en: Geometry/port/transform VBA aligned with CST Online Help dumps in vba_cst/.
vba_reference_note.tr: Geometri/port/transform VBA’ları vba_cst/ içindeki CST Online Help dökümüyle hizalandı.
